FIELDS.NAME: Canvas & Craft Gallery
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Art St, Suite 456, New York, NY 10001-5678
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Canvas & Craft Gallery, we operate as a retail art gallery and supply store, providing a curated selection of artworks from local and emerging artists, as well as an extensive range of art supplies for hobbyists and professionals. Our gallery hosts regular exhibitions and community events, designed to engage the public and promote artistic expression. We maintain a diverse collection of artworks and implement high-security measures, including state-of-the-art alarm systems and surveillance cameras, to protect our high-value inventory. We adhere strictly to all local, state, and federal regulations and prioritize safety through regular staff training on customer service and loss prevention practices. To mitigate risk, we employ robust fire and water protection systems, ensuring a safe environment for both our customers and our artworks. Our commitment to maintaining documented safety protocols for art supplies ensures compliance and protects our staff and patrons from potential hazards. Moreover, we have implemented documented cybersecurity measures to protect our digital sales channels, enhancing our customers' confidence in our online transaction processes.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a water leak from a neighboring unit caused damage to a section of our art supply inventory, totaling $2,500. The affected items were documented and disposed of following our inventory management practices. The claim has been settled, and we have since reinforced our inventory storage methods to mitigate future risks.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $5,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday: 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Closed on Sundays.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B safe, UL-listed, suitable for high-value art storage.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Enhanced security measures, including 24-hour surveillance and a gated exterior, implemented to protect the gallery's high-value inventory from theft and vandalism risks.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Canvas & Craft Gallery does not engage in operations involving the storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting of hazardous materials, focusing instead on retail art sales and supplies. FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with Canvas & Craft Gallery or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years for Canvas & Craft Gallery. We maintain our insurance requirements and compliance standards to ensure continuous coverage.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Canvas & Craft Gallery does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our staff is directly employed by the gallery.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Canvas & Craft Gallery carries Workers Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with state regulations and to protect both the business and its employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Canvas & Craft Gallery also operates "Art & Craft Supply Co., LLC," which focuses on providing a range of craft supplies. This subsidiary complements our main business of art sales and supplies.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Canvas & Craft Gallery does not have any other insurance policies with the current company. The only policy listed is for the gallery's main operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Canvas & Craft Gallery is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. We focus exclusively on retail art sales and supplies.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Canvas & Craft Gallery does not rent or loan equipment to others as our focus is primarily on retail art sales and supplies. We maintain all equipment for our own operations and community events.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Canvas & Craft Gallery has not experienced a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial standing and adheres to sound financial practices.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Canvas & Craft Gallery does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus on retail art sales and supplies, adhering strictly to safety protocols.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Canvas & Craft Gallery does not have any known catastrophe exposure, as our operations are focused on art retail with robust risk management strategies in place. We maintain comprehensive safety protocols and adhere to all local regulations to mitigate potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Canvas & Craft Gallery has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize compliance and maintain a safe and respectful environment for all staff and patrons.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Canvas & Craft Gallery does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, as we prioritize compliance with all fire safety regulations and maintain a safe environment for our patrons and artworks.
